name: InitItemColumn
evidence: runs the base init and sets the four items' vtable to D_00218330 and calls its slot 0 with 0x12

name: SetupItemColumn
evidence: slot 1 of the item column table D_00218720: sets up its text (SetupScreenElementText), then each of its four items' slot 1, font scale 0.8 and slide times 1, 1 and 0

name: UpdateItemColumn
evidence: runs the base update (func_001AAF58) then slot 17 of each of the four items with the clock

name: UpdateItemColumnSlide
evidence: slot 2 of the item column table D_00218720: runs UpdateScreenElementSlide, then slot 2 of each of its items up to its count

name: DrawItemColumn
evidence: when D_00275BEC is 1, stacks the four items downward from y, setting each one's x, y and a scaled blend, calling its slot 9 and restoring the blend

name: ResizeItemColumn
evidence: stores an offset and a count n and sizes the column to the font height times scale times n

name: ClearItemColumn
evidence: calls the item column's slot 16 with mode 0, as ResetScreenElement does (RunAnimationEvent calls it on g_stackedCaptionGroup)

name: PostItemColumnEntry
evidence: original assembly: RunAnimationEvent passes it g_stackedCaptionGroup, two words of its event and a fraction (a byte times 1/256)
